title: Transaction-cost encoding robustness
description: Quantum portfolio studies rarely isolate whether transaction-cost encodings remain robust as asset count grows.
why_existing_work_does_not_solve_it: Reported results often confound encoding choice with solver noise and scale.
minimum_experiment_needed: Compare encodings against classical solvers across asset counts and noise levels.
risk_that_gap_is_fake: A specialized quantum finance benchmark may already report this ablation.
